रुध् {vI.v} {c7c} U. (रुणद्धि, रुंद्धे, रुरोध, रुरुधे,
अरुधत्-अरौत्सीत्-अरुद्ध, रोत्स्यति-ते, रोद्धुं,
रुद्ध; desid. रुरुत्सति-ते)
1 To obstruct,
stop, arrest, check, oppose, hinder;
impede, prevent इदं रुणद्धि मां
पद्ममंतःकूजितषट्पदं

.
--2 To hold up, preserve,
sustain (from falling); आशाबंधः
कुसुमसदृशं प्रायशो ह्यंगनानां सद्यःपाति
प्रणयि हृदयं विप्रयोगे रुणद्धि

.
--3
(a) To shut up, lock or block up,
close up, shut or close; (with loc.,
but sometimes with two acc.);

; व्रजं रुणद्धि गां Sk. (b) To
surround, fence or hem in.
--4 To
bind, confine; व्यालं
बालमृणालतंतुभिरसौ रोद्धुं समुज्जृभते

.
--5 To
besiege, invest, blockade; रुंधंतु
वारणघटा नगरं मदीयाः

.
--6 To hide, cover,
obscure, conceal.
--7 To oppress,
torment, afflict excessively. --

To cause to stop, detain, impede,
obstruct.
--2 To fetter, confine,
chain.
--3 To oppress, torment,
harass. {vII.v} {c1c} P. (रोधति) To grow,
germinate, cf. रुह्.

रुधिर a. [रुध्-किरच्] Red, red
coloured.
--रं
1 Blood.
--2 Saffron.
--रः
1 The red colour.
--2 The
planet Mars.
--Comp.
--अशनः ‘a
blood-eater’, a demon, an evil spirit.
--आख्यः a kind of precious stone.
--आननं one of the five retrograding
motions of Mars.
--आमयः
hemorrhage, piles.
--उद्गारिन् a. emitting
blood.
--पायिन् m. a demon.
